profile.headline:
Software Engineer II
Master of Science in IT Management
profile.summary:
I am an experienced computer engineer with more than 9 years of experience in the information technology field. My main focus is on building efficient applications at the enterprise level. Normally, I am out of my comfort zone as I am always eager to support he business in whichever area is needed. This attitude has enabled me to take on various roles, including lead for fellow developers, on-call support for production, contributor to building automation systems, DevOps, and direct communication with enterprise clients. I am always seeking new challenges and have consistently demonstrated my commitment to them. 

I have always been passionate about computers and programming since an early age. 

In my spare time, I enjoy playing chess with my friends. Teach martial arts to people of all ages and continue to advance my journey of mastery by combining Taekwondo, Judo, and Brazilian Jiujitsu. Moreover, I continue to learn multiple languages, such as French and German, on a daily basis. 

I spend a significant amount of time studying courses and pursuing degrees that will enable me to contribute more to the endeavors I undertake.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, I build 'Software As A Service' applications using an agentic, agile process with a Java (Spring Boot) and JavaScript (React.js) technology stack in the cloud environment (AWS). These are built with object-oriented designs and design patterns.

In the Java stack, I build web services using technologies such as REST and microservices. 

Responsible for creating unit tests in a continuous integration and deployment environment and providing code quality metrics.

I support the QA team by creating automation scripts that test the API layer using TestNG and the UI layer using Selenium (Selenium Grid).

My role spans both Full-Stack and QA Engineering, with Full-Stack as my main focus.

By using agentic technologies, I increased my delivery speed and built more complex features.
positions.insights: Skills: ChatGPT · Anthropic Claude · Claude Code · Spring Boot · React.js

positions.title: Senior Black Belt Voluntary Certified Instructor
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer responsible for creating Web Services, Web Applications, and Mobile Applications. Working with Frontend and Backend technologies. Worked with Salesforce Integration via REST endpoints. Modified an existing Apex class and Remote Site Setting to achieve the business desired functionality. 

Spring Boot: SOA Web Services, Openshift, Git, Bitbucket, OpenAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Postman, and Oracle SQL

Angular 6, Jasmine and Karma

Have been lightly involved with work using the following tech stacks:
.NET Core and .NET Framework
Swift
Android

positions.title: Java/Spring Developer
positions.description:
Spring development with Java v8 and most recent technologies in the market.

Development in US Institutions (Fannie Mae and Brown Brothers Harriman) :
Experience in Java v8, Spring (Spring modules, Batch, Integration, MVC), Sprint Boot, Web Services, Hibernate, JUnit 5, JSPs, JSF 2.2, JEE, Maven, Angular 7, 8, Thymeleaf, AWS, Shell scripting, OracleSQL (PLSQL), DB2, Sybase, and MSSQL. Using tools like Jenkins, Nexus, Git, Tortoise SVN, Serena Dimensions, Oracle Toad, Confluence, Jira, Spring Tools Suite, IntelliJ, Eclipse, and Citrix. Patterns: DTO, DAO, Singleton, Builder, and MVC.

Instructor in the following topics:
Backend Testing (ETL, Dataware Housing, Unix)
Automation Testing 
PL/SQL - Stored Procedures, Triggers, Functions, and Packages

Knowledge in:
DevOps (Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment)
Docker
Automation Testing with Selenium
Agile/Scrum/Kanban
Test-Driven Development
Behavior Driven Testing
